exceptions.mitigation: The package is reachable only through the local MCP Inspector CLI and the demo's build-time ESLint/checker graph; Better Convex exposes no user-controlled glob interface, repository tooling supplies the inputs, and shipped runtime plus standalone starter production audits exclude this development-only graph.
exceptions.reason: Upstream published the memory-bound fix only in the API-incompatible 5.x line. The official MCP Inspector CLI and demo build tooling still resolve minimatch 3 / brace-expansion 1, so forcing 5.x would break those callers; retain the exact development tools until their upstream graphs adopt a compatible patched release.
